product.name: Memory Evaluation Workbench
product.positioning: Custom memory-agent benchmark workbench for LoCoMo-first evaluation.
product.north_star: A tester can import memory, run QA, judge answers, and export an evidence-rich HTML report without leaking API keys.

agent.label: MemoryBench Agent
agent.formal_score_source: LoCoMo evaluation reports, not the interactive chat page
forbidden_context: raw conversation fallback in formal score

sidebar.label: 对话
sidebar.purpose: Interactive MemoryBench Agent debugging with relevant memory, context trace, and manual memory write.

sidebar.label: LoCoMo
sidebar.purpose: Primary LoCoMo entry: open memory import first, then continue to QA, judging, report export, history, and diff.

sidebar.label: LongMemEval
sidebar.purpose: Long-context memory benchmark entry; MemoryBench memory-QA and official-style adapters must be clearly separated.

sidebar.label: HotpotQA
sidebar.purpose: Multi-hop QA benchmark entry with answer metrics and future supporting-fact metrics.

sidebar.label: ProAgentBench
sidebar.purpose: Agent task benchmark entry; official runner work remains separate from LoCoMo scoring.

sidebar.label: Tau2-bench
sidebar.purpose: Tool-task benchmark entry; official tool environment work remains separate from LoCoMo scoring.

sidebar.label: 系统配置
sidebar.purpose: Per-account backend selection, workspace, model configuration, readiness, and handoff gates.

delivery_boundary.historical_static_policy: Other HTML files under web/static are experiment history or generated reports, not public entrypoints.
